name: thinking-token-budget
note: Upstream d07889da0 (Go 2392e66). vLLM-style server: compat.supportsThinkingTokenBudget emits top-level thinking_token_budget capping reasoning tokens, clamped to always leave MIN_ANSWER_TOKENS (1024) for the answer. No caller maxTokens, model maxTokens 16384, reasoning high -> min(16384, 16384-1024) = 15360. Also exercises the zai thinking-object interplay on the same request. Shipped in pi-ai 0.84.2; backend flipped to dist (README rule).
